# FDG4059

> DO apply the following informational attributes to assemblies. These attributes are used by tools, such as Visual Studio, to inform the user of the assembly about its contents.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.10 Types and Assembly Metadata.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG4059
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: draft

Message: Apply {0} to the assembly

Library only: the attributes inform the users of an assembly through tools. FDG4059 reports, once per attribute and without a source location, an assembly with externally visible types that lacks AssemblyTitleAttribute, AssemblyCompanyAttribute, AssemblyProductAttribute or AssemblyDescriptionAttribute, the four the book lists. SDK-style projects generate the first three, and AssemblyDescription only when the Description property is set.

## From the book

```csharp
[assembly:AssemblyTitle("System.Core.dll")]
[assembly:AssemblyCompany("Microsoft Corporation")]
[assembly:AssemblyProduct("Microsoft .NET Framework")]
[assembly:AssemblyDescription(...)]
```
